gloss: for a long time, forever, enduringly

definitions.gloss: for a long time to come, forever, lastingly
definitions.explanation: Expresses the wish or expectation that something will continue far into the future. Commonly used in well-wishes and formal expressions, especially at weddings and in greetings.

examples.japanese: {末永|すえなが}くお{幸|しあわ}せに。
どうぞ{末永|すえなが}くよろしくお{願|ねが}いいたします。
examples.english: I look forward to our continued relationship for a long time to come.

examples.japanese: この{伝統|でんとう}が{末永|すえなが}く{受|う}け{継|つ}がれていくことを{願|ねが}っています。
examples.english: I hope this tradition will be passed down for many years to come.

notes:
USAGE:
{末永|すえなが}く is an adverb used in well-wishes and formal expressions. It conveys the hope that a positive state will continue indefinitely into the future.

The most iconic usage is the wedding blessing {末永|すえなが}くお{幸|しあわ}せに (May you be happy forever). It also appears in business greetings and formal letters to express a wish for a lasting relationship.

ETYMOLOGY:
From {末|すえ} (the future, what comes after) + {永|なが}い (long) in its adverbial く form — literally "long into the future."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {末永|すえなが}くお{幸|しあわ}せに: may you be happy forever
- {末永|すえなが}くよろしく: I look forward to a lasting relationship
- {末永|すえなが}く{愛|あい}される: to be loved for a long time
- {末永|すえなが}く{続|つづ}く: to last for a long time
